violations.text: No person certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (shelves underneath front counter) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

The floors in the basement area near dry storage/supplies storage has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Inadequate lighting was observed in the walk-in cooler. 6-303.11 Intensity. The light intensity shall be: -At least 108 lux (10 foot candles) at 75 cm (30 inches) above the floor, in walk-in refrigeration units and dry FOOD storage areas and in other areas and rooms during periods of cleaning; -At least 540 lux (50 foot candles) at a surface where a FOOD EMPLOYEE is working with FOOD or working with UTENSILS or EQUIPMENT such as knives, slicers, grinders, or saws where EMPLOYEE safety is a factor. -Establishment shall replace bulbs with a brighter one. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back of kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2025

The floors throughout the basement and under shelving in the kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2025

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by rodent droppings observed on the floor in the dry storage area (basement) and warewashing area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 05/22/2024
Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package in the dry storage area (basement). Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/22/2024
The floor in the basement is in poor repair, inspector observed holes. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair New Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2024

The floors in the dry storage area (basement) and warewashing area have an accumulation of rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/22/2024
